DESCRIPTION: At the start of its turn, lose HP equal to its Bleed stacks, then remove all Bleed. When a Bleeding creature takes unblocked attack damage, it gains #b1 Bleed.
Every #b5 Sin you have grants #b1 Debt.
Each stack of Debt makes you take #b10% more damage.
You cannot gain [E] unless you fully remove all of your Debt. Removed at the end of your turn.
